body:
**5.0/en/0x05-For-Users-Of-4.0.md** 

a. In Introduction, replace verion with version
b. In Introduction, consider changing "...mapping documents are provided to help users trace how requirements..."  to "...mapping documents are provided to help users trace requirements..."
c. In Scope and Focus, consider changing "Version 4.x included requirements that did not align with the intended scope of the standard; these have been removed" to " Version 4.x included requirements that fell outside the standard's intended scope have been removed."

comments.body: Thanks, a) is a silly mistake, b) and c) are fine as they are.

You are correct it is a silly issue, sorry for having you to go through the PR chain for this small one . Though, it was my first time to report such a change and a bigger learning for me, so I am happy I did it to gain the experience and thanks for acknowledging. I will continue reading through the other main chapters (V1 to V17) during the day and could revert back when I stumble upon a change. Thanks for your contribution.

Thanks for your review, note that we are going to release on Friday no matter what so we may not be able to guarantee including all of your feedback but we will try, if not now then in the future
Also please open a separate issue each time you finish doing a review session so that feedback can be incorporated each time
